description: She wears a floor-length burgundy gown with a velvet-like surface, a fitted structured bodice, low square neckline and sleeves ending around the elbows. Broad gold-toned embroidered borders frame the neckline, waist, central front and hem. An ivory patterned underdress shows through the open front skirt. A cream and gold patterned shoulder wrap rests along both arms and hangs at the sides. A decorative circular belt fitting, small pendant necklace and earrings provide modest jewelry. Brown shoes appear beneath the hem. The neckline shows the upper chest, while substantial opaque cloth covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis. Exact fabric fibers cannot be verified.
